description: Runtime status for the Unifabric Agent, container resources, and OpenTelemetry Collector.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Agent process CPU cores, from process_cpu_seconds_total.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: RSS and Go heap bytes in use.

panels.title: GC
panels.description: GC runs per second and GC pause p99.

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: File descriptors held by the agent, including uprobe links, maps and /proc scans.

panels.title: Heap allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated per second, the allocation pressure of the event path.

panels.title: Send event rate
panels.description: Events per second read from the ring buffer, kept by sampling and dropped by full queues.

panels.title: Storage writes
panels.description: Rows per second written and failed per sink, and the connection state (1 is connected).

panels.title: Write queue length
panels.description: Rows waiting per sink, staying near the queue size means the backend cannot keep up.

panels.title: Storage insert duration
panels.description: Batch write duration p50 and p99 per sink.

panels.title: BPF map entries
panels.description: Entries in qp_infos and qp_stats, both sized 8192 with LRU eviction near the limit.

panels.title: QP join results
panels.description: Entries per report joined with a destination, without one, and skipped because both ends did not resolve to Pods.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: Time Prometheus spends scraping the agent /metrics, rising with series growth.

panels.title: Instance availability
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the controller; 1 means online.

panels.title: Controller CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used by the controller process.

panels.title: Controller memory
panels.description: Controller process RSS and Go heap memory.

panels.title: Controller goroutines and threads
panels.description: Goroutines and operating system threads in the controller Go runtime.

panels.title: Reconcile throughput and errors
panels.description: Reconcile results per second and explicit errors for each controller.

panels.title: Reconcile P99 latency
panels.description: P99 reconcile duration for each controller.

panels.title: Agent CPU and limit
panels.description: Container CPU cores from cAdvisor and the limit derived from the cgroup quota. cAdvisor scrapes every 15s, the rate window is fixed at 1m so every point has a value.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_quota{namespace="unifabric", container="agent", pod=~".*-agent-.*"})
/ sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_period{namespace="unifabric", container="agent", pod=~".*-agent-.*"})

panels.title: Agent memory working set and limit
panels.description: Container working set and memory limit from cAdvisor, approaching the limit leads to OOMKill.

panels.title: Agent CPU throttling ratio
panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled according to cAdvisor, staying above 0 means the CPU limit is too low. cAdvisor scrapes every 15s, the rate window is fixed at 1m so every point has a value.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="unifabric", container="agent", pod=~".*-agent-.*"}[1m]))
/ (sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="unifabric", container="agent", pod=~".*-agent-.*"}[1m])) > 0)

panels.title: Controller CPU and limit
panels.description: Controller container CPU cores and cgroup CPU limit from cAdvisor.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_quota{namespace="unifabric", container="controller", pod=~".*-controller-.*"})
/ sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_period{namespace="unifabric", container="controller", pod=~".*-controller-.*"})

panels.title: Controller memory working set and limit
panels.description: Controller container working set and memory limit from cAdvisor.

panels.title: Controller CPU throttling ratio
panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled for the Controller container.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="unifabric", container="controller", pod=~".*-controller-.*"}[1m]))
/ (sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="unifabric", container="controller", pod=~".*-controller-.*"}[1m])) > 0)

panels.title: ClickHouse CPU and limit
panels.description: cAdvisor scrapes every 15s, the rate window is fixed at 1m so every point has a value.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_quota{namespace="unifabric", container="clickhouse", pod=~".*clickhouse.*"})
/ sum by (pod) (container_spec_cpu_period{namespace="unifabric", container="clickhouse", pod=~".*clickhouse.*"})

panels.title: ClickHouse memory working set and limit
ClickHouse CPU throttling ratio

panels.title: Received and exported records
panels.description: Log records received per second and records sent successfully per exporter.

panels.description: Send failures per exporter and the current sending queue size.

panels.description: CPU and RSS from the Collector's own metrics.
